profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I have 7+ years experience with Java working with web services, microservices, AWS cloud services, front end and back end. As well as ruby experience for small scripts, and the Chef automation suite for deployment.

I'm passionate about CI/CD, unit testing, and integration testing. Two teammates and myself re-built our Jenkins CI pipeline from scratch. All configuration managed through code; leverage AWS for scalable build servers to react to need; it created build jobs automatically for tasks in progress to run unit and integration tests so they could be part of code review completion.

Mentored and managed the work for 10+ new hires(and one intern), one or two at a time, to make sure they were up to speed with my company's expectations of new engineers.
